import sys,subprocess,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(sys.argv[1]);pin=sys.argv[2]
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-optional-locks','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root).decode().strip()==pin
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-optional-locks','status','--porcelain'],cwd=root)
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from workflow_delivery_tree import Tree
from workflow_delivery_io import canonical_json
historical=Tree(root,revision=pin);contract=historical.json('specs/workflow_delivery/rollout.contract.json');manifest=historical.manifest(contract['input_roots'])
assert manifest==Tree(root).manifest(contract['input_roots']) and len(manifest)==152
assert hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(manifest)).hexdigest()=='ab90c27b89f820df22200fc8ed1c200faae5536b7a28d64b14ae25869fc03564'
count=0
for row in manifest:
 if row['path'].endswith('.py'):
  compile((root/row['path']).read_bytes(),row['path'],'exec');count+=1
print(json.dumps({'source_commit':pin,'input_count':len(manifest),'python_modules_compiled_in_memory':count,'source_clean':True,'compilation_output_written':False}))
